svg.text: ORIGINAL EDUCATIONAL DESIGN - printed 8-53 / PDF 431. Companion CAD and AVI unavailable.
25 occurrences / 16 definitions; two KT16 sleeves and one extra KT06 retainer added.
Dimensions in mm. Ideal RH 2 mm lead; smooth nominal thread envelopes.
Guided flat-workpiece mode: jaw opening 56 to 10 mm; native travel limit retained.
Alloy Steel 7.70 g/cm3; KT13 NBR-770 1.30 g/cm3 reference. No rated load capacity.
Exploded offsets are for presentation; physical home and 36 native mates are preserved.
